name: Cast to TV
description: Casts whatever's currently airing to a Chromecast/Google TV device on the LAN, kept in sync with the live schedule.

ipc.why: scans the LAN (mDNS) for Chromecast/Google TV devices to list in the settings panel
connects to the Chromecast/Google TV device you selected from the scan
closes the connection to the cast device
loads whatever is currently airing onto the connected cast device
stops playback on the cast device
sets the cast device's receiver volume
turns on/off automatically keeping the cast device in sync with channel changes and drift
receives the currently-playing local file/position from the renderer so it can be served to the cast device
reports connection/casting status back to the settings panel

net.why: serves the currently-airing local video file to the Chromecast/Google TV device over the LAN, and receives its status callbacks
